{{Quote|Okay, okay. Fenrol Jarkey wanted to smuggle some spice into Theed, and I was going to help him sell it. But now he's dead, the stupid drunk. And I didn't even know he had a brother, so back off. Try talking to his father.|[[Derm Worrit]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:FaEM" />}}
'''Ados Jarkey''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who lived on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was the father of [[Fenrol Jarkey|Fenrol]] and [[Hunnos Jarkey]]. His son Hunnos was a murderer wanted by the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]. Some time after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], agents of the [[Royal Security Police Force|Violent Crimes Division]] interrogated him about his escaped son. In the meantime, his other son Fenrol killed himself in a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] accident.<ref name="SWG:FaEM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ados Jarkey appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:FaEM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Ados Jarkey was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
